comment: None of the 22 inputs is named in configInput, so Rack's tooltips are blank on all of them. Particles[], ParticlesCopy[], Settings and colorshift are file-scope globals (src/ColoredGlass.cpp:46-78), not members, so every instance in a patch writes the same state; the last module's process() of each frame decides what all of them draw. The randomness jacks on EDGES and STROKE add a whole unit per volt while their knobs run only 0 to 1, whereas the other randomness jacks add a tenth per volt; the scalings are at src/ColoredGlass.cpp:168-188. RESET is a level test on the sum of the button and the jack, so a held gate above 0V restores the starting particles on every frame. The RED, GREEN and BLUE results are cast to an unsigned byte by nvgRGBA, so negative settings wrap; the factory default for RED is -9. There are no outputs.
